entries.unknownDefersToCi: HAMCIAUTH-01: every validation-deferred receipt records cleanCheckout. CI continuation requires cleanup=finished, localFailureObserved=false, no failed row in the final check receipt, an eligible reason, declared contexts and cleanCheckout=true; legacy receipts continue only with coverageComplete=true. A controller-owned stop is rewritten with cleanup=finished and the re-judged ciAuthoritative after the controller certifies drain.

entries.publishedCiContinuation: HAMCIAUTH-01: the watcher continues an uncontinued clean hold whose sourceHead is the live PR head, recording publishedHead, when the attempt's deferred.json and validation.json show a deferrable UNKNOWN with no local failure and the repository declares required contexts.
